description: Reverie full validation as a dagrun DAG (one node per gate; selected with --labels full). Authored 2026-11-05 from measured per-node wall/CPU/RSS at 83cff0aa; dagrun's profile feedback refines widths and memory caps from recorded runs.

steps.description: Runs scripts/check-skill-discovery.rs, the same check the serial validate.sh ran first.
cargo fmt --all -- --check over the whole workspace.

Builds every workspace test binary once (--all-features) and records nextest binaries-metadata plus the full test list under target/validate/. Every test node runs from this metadata, so no test node rebuilds and feature unification is the workspace's. This replaces the serial driver's separate `cargo build --workspace --all-features` gate: measured 2026-11-05, all 274 artifact identities of that build are compiled by the test build (420 identities), and lint.clippy --all-targets additionally compiles the non-test lib profile, so dropping the duplicate build loses no compile coverage. Memory: a cold width-16 build OOM-killed at a 16 GB cap (peak 16.0 GB, 6 oom_kills, 2026-11-05); width 12 with a 24 GB baseline / 48 GB hard cap follows dagrun's size-above-recorded-peak rule.
steps.cmd: mkdir -p target/validate && cargo nextest list --workspace --all-features --list-type binaries-only --message-format json > target/validate/binaries-metadata.json && cargo nextest list --binaries-metadata target/validate/binaries-metadata.json --message-format json --list-type full > target/validate/list-full.json

steps.description: Counted nextest over reverie-liteinst binaries strace, generic_bootstrap, standalone_constructor, tool_tls, fixed_arena, the lib tests, and the zero-case guest binaries. Binary lists in the two LiteInst nodes partition the package; validate.sh refuses if node totals drift from the workspace list.
steps.cmd: ./scripts/libtest-counts.rs run-nextest target/validate/counts-test-liteinst_a.json -- cargo nextest run --binaries-metadata target/validate/binaries-metadata.json -E "(package(reverie-liteinst) & (binary(=strace) | binary(=generic_bootstrap) | binary(=standalone_constructor) | binary(=tool_tls) | binary(=fixed_arena) | binary(=reverie_liteinst) | binary(=reverie-liteinst-trap-count-guest) | binary(=reverie-liteinst-strace) | binary(=reverie-liteinst-spoof-guest) | binary(=reverie-liteinst-rpc-tool-guest) | binary(=reverie-liteinst-lifecycle-guest))) & $REVERIE_NEXTEST_SKIP_FILTER"

steps.description: Counted nextest over the launch_descriptor_window binary alone, at low width. These tests race two tracer launches against a held transient descriptor and a sub-second overlap window (they already self-serialize in-process via a SERIAL mutex); under full-DAG load at width 32 the window closed before the launch waited, failing EMFILE (measured 2026-11-05, load 65-157). Isolating the binary at width 4 keeps its sibling launches from starving the window; the tests themselves stay parallel-unsafe by design and are named here rather than serialized silently. Scheduled after test.liteinst_a (the heaviest CPU node): these tests measure sub-second launch/trap timing windows that full-DAG CPU burst contention closes (measured 2026-11-05: PASS in isolation at width 16/4, EMFILE/SIGSYS-miss under concurrent cold/warm DAG load).
steps.cmd: ./scripts/libtest-counts.rs run-nextest target/validate/counts-test-ptrace_launch.json -- cargo nextest run --binaries-metadata target/validate/binaries-metadata.json -E "(package(reverie-ptrace) & binary(=launch_descriptor_window)) & $REVERIE_NEXTEST_SKIP_FILTER"

Also after test.ptrace (the longest node): the smoke spoof-getpid trap-arming race still fired with only the LiteInst burst removed.
